detail:
Field defect D9 (wave-2 handoff 2026-08-12) confirmed in full, three coupled mechanisms:

1. total_matched lies: DecisionEngine.searchDecisions reports searchResults.results.length (engine path, decisions.ts:1031) and topResults.length after slice(0, maxResults) (keyword fallback, decisions.ts:1090). SearchEngine.searchDecisions (embeddings/search.ts:158-161) returns only the sliced page — the true pre-slice count (scored.length) is computed and discarded at search.ts:157-159. Hence total_matched === min(limit, matches), exactly the field measurement (limit 5→5, 20→20, 50→50, 200→200). Field nuance confirmed: status filters shrink the corpus BEFORE search (decisions.ts:985-999), so when the filtered population < limit the page length equals the real count — the count is honest only below page size.

2. Ranker always returns something: the semantic path (search.ts:137-155) scores EVERY decision that has an embedding via cosineSimilarity and pushes unconditionally — no threshold, no is_noise. MiniLM cosine on unrelated text sits ~0.26-0.28 (field-measured floor), so nonsense queries return a confident top-k with fallback_mode:false. Note asymmetry: both keyword fallback paths DO gate on score > 0 (search.ts:151, :176; decisions.ts:1070), so the pathology is exclusive to the semantic path.

3. No lifecycle in rank: decisionStore.getIndex() returns all statuses; without a status filter the corpus includes superseded/overridden/archived and rank is raw cosine — a superseded original systematically outranks its terser amendment (field measured 0.6954 vs 0.5418). Result rows do carry status, but nothing weights or flags it.

Tool description (decision-tools.ts:356-357) documents none of this: no "absence is not expressible", no noise floor, no scope-filtered alternative pointer.

Fix shape matching the field's cheapest-first asks: (a) add pre-slice count to SearchResults interface and plumb it through as total_matched (or rename field to returned) — pure plumbing, the value already exists at search.ts:157; (b) state the ~0.26 noise floor + absence-not-expressible caveat in the tool description; (c) optionally threshold or flag sub-floor relevance.
summary: D9 root-caused: total_matched is post-slice page length (decisions.ts:1031,1090); semantic path pushes every embedded decision with no noise threshold (search.ts:142); rank ignores lifecycle entirely
